title: KHADAM
synopsis: Melor, who is forced to inherit her family's inheritance. As a result, she must race against time to save her daughter from a dark entity that is beginning to take over her life.

synopsis_lang.en: Melor, who is forced to inherit her family's inheritance. As a result, she must race against time to save her daughter from a dark entity that is beginning to take over her life.
synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
傳説中，有一種馬來民間的世襲家族巫術—— 靈僕。
靈僕，聽命於契約主人，替其消災解厄，但一切皆有代價。

 

梅羅為了保護年幼的孩子，無奈繼承家族靈僕。後來怪事連連發生，家人性命岌岌可危，惡鬼僕匿匿，她已經無法離開這個家⋯⋯

cast: Aghniny Haque, Remy Ishak, Siti Khadijah Halim
